Meze tavern · Kallipoleos, Nicosia

Kontosouvli, meze and music

A small family-run tavern named after the dish it is known for, with home-style meze. On Google, 4.6 stars from 67 reviews.

Food

What guests order

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Kontosouvli

The namesake dish. Guests describe it as soft and juicy, and one calls it the most delicious in town.

Meze

A good variety of traditional meze, with flavours guests compare to home cooking.

From the grill

Chicken souvlaki, beef kebab, mushrooms and halloumi.

Music nights

Some evenings end with the owner and his friends playing music, guests write.

At the tavern

Photo from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Family-run

Guests write about warm, helpful owners and very polite people.

Book a table

A small place, so guests recommend booking a table early.

Fair prices

One reviewer calls the food fairly priced, with a good variety of meze.

Named after the dish

A small, warm tavern on Kallipoleos Street, named after the kontosouvli it is known for. Simple, wholesome food and a neighbourhood feeling.

What guests say

Three of 67 Google reviews, 52 of them with five stars.
